title: Final Temperature Comparison
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that T_He > T_Air as a result of the adiabatic compression process.

title: Adiabatic Process Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should reference the adiabatic process equation and explain its relevance to the problem.

title: Gamma Values Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and compare the gamma values for helium and air, explaining their significance in the context of compression.

title: Ideal Gas Law Reference
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the ideal gas law and its role in understanding the behavior of gases under compression.

title: Common Errors Identification
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as neglecting the differences in specific heats or misapplying the adiabatic condition.
